name: Resourceful Automobile Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2018, Resourceful Automobile 
Ltd is in the business of sale of bikes and other related services etc.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RAL is engaged in the dealership of Yamaha two-wheelers, operating 2 showrooms under the name Sawhney Automobiles. The company specializes in the sales and servicing of motorcycles and scooters.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.93 times its book value
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 26.0%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.1.29 Cr.
Debtor days have increased from 39.1 to 90.7 days.
Working capital days have increased from 215 days to 315 days
